articles.summary: PROVO, Utah --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 28, 2026-- Green Dot Corporation (NYSE: GDOT) will release its first quarter 2026 financial results concurrent with the filing of its Form 10-Q for the period ended March 31, 2026, which will be filed on or before May 11, 2026.
articles.title: Green Dot to Announce First Quarter 2026 Results
